claims.statement: CoinPaprika resolved AERO to Aerodrome Finance, coin ID aero-aerodrome-finance, and returned contract 0x940181a94A35A4569E4529A3CDfB74e38FD98631. The returned contract entry is typed 'Other'; this response does not independently establish Base chain attribution.

At CoinPaprika last_updated 2026-10-16T11:15:15Z, AERO was $0.9250627991 USD, with reported market cap $928,958,574, 24-hour volume $87,855,316.63, circulating supply 1,004,211,363 AERO, and total supply 2,002,379,494 AERO. CoinPaprika's returned circulating supply is the basis associated with its market cap; its supply methodology was not included in the response.

Using CoinPaprika daily USD point-in-time prices at 00:00 UTC on 2026-10-16 versus matching 00:00 UTC endpoints: AERO returned +14.18% over 7 days (0.815465 to 0.931106), +18.15% over 14 days (0.788059 to 0.931106), and +20.39% over 21 days (0.773378 to 0.931106). Formula: (ending price / starting price - 1) × 100.

On the same daily USD endpoints and formula, BTC returned -0.49%, -3.94%, and -2.46% over 7, 14, and 21 days; ETH returned -1.78%, -9.81%, and -9.12%. AERO outperformed BTC by 14.67, 22.09, and 22.85 percentage points, and ETH by 15.96, 27.96, and 29.51 percentage points, respectively. These are matched price-return comparisons, not risk-adjusted returns.

Across the returned 21-day daily observations, AERO's lowest and highest sampled prices were $0.773378 on 2026-09-25 and $0.954614 on 2026-10-11. These are observed daily sample extrema, not independently validated support or resistance levels.

The current ticker quote was updated at 11:15:15Z on 2026-10-16 and reports +13.86% over 7 days, while matched 00:00 UTC daily history endpoints yield +14.18%. The values use different observation times/windows and are not treated as a conflict.

coverage_gaps.description: CoinPaprika resolution returned the AERO contract with contract type 'Other' and did not return a chain/platform identifier. Therefore this response alone does not verify that the asset record is specifically the Base deployment.

No second qualified market-data provider was used. CoinGecko's only allowlisted tool in the repository capability snapshot is search_docs; its execute tool is UNKNOWN and not allowlisted, so no CoinGecko market observation was retrieved.
No qualified technical-indicator or OHLCV source was available within the used allowlist. Daily sampled extrema are reported as historical observations only, not formal support/resistance.
CoinPaprika returned circulating and total supply values, but this response did not provide the supply calculation methodology or unlock/emissions schedule.
